    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AWS EKS部署Prometheus和Grafana</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>一、创建Prometheus工作区</p>
<p>1.创建工作区</p>
<p>为了可以把Prometheus数据写入到AWS managed Prometheus，需要先在AWS Prometheus控制台中创建工作区</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="704" height="273" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/865838/202510/865838-20251019084533383-384211163.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.保存工作区配置&nbsp;</p>
<p>点击AWS Prometheus工作区ID进入详情，将<strong>提取/收集 </strong>中的配置保存为prometheus.yaml，后面会在安装prometheus时使用。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="701" height="433" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/865838/202510/865838-20251019085351596-1548404765.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;3.创建从EKS提取指标的role</p>
<p>&nbsp;使用以下内容创建名为&nbsp;<code>createIRSA-AMPIngest.sh</code>&nbsp;的文件。将&nbsp;<code class="code">&lt;my_amazon_eks_clustername&gt;</code>&nbsp;替换为您集群的名称，并将&nbsp;<code class="code">&lt;my_prometheus_namespace&gt;</code>&nbsp;替换为您的 Prometheus 命名空间</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>#!/bin/bash -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e
CLUSTER_NAME</span>=&lt;my_amazon_eks_clustername&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAMESPACE</span>=&lt;my_prometheus_namespace&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
AWS_ACCOUNT_ID</span>=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Account</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output text)
OIDC_PROVIDER</span>=$(aws eks describe-cluster --name $CLUSTER_NAME --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cluster.identity.oidc.issuer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --output text | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sed</span> -e <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s/^https:\/\///</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_AMP_INGEST_NAME</span>=amp-iamproxy-ingest-service-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">account
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE</span>=amp-iamproxy-ingest-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">role
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_POLICY</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">AMPIngestPolicy
#
# Set up a trust policy designed </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> a specific combination of K8s service account and namespace to sign <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> from a Kubernetes cluster <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">which</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hosts the OIDC Idp.

  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Version</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2012-10-17</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,                   
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Statement</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
    {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Effect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Allow</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Principal</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Federated</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">arn:aws:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:oidc-provider/${OIDC_PROVIDER}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      },
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Action</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Condition</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">StringEquals</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${OIDC_PROVIDER}:sub</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system:serviceaccount:${SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAMESPACE}:${SERVICE_ACCOUNT_AMP_INGEST_NAME}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        }

# Set up the permission policy that grants ingest (remote </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">write</span>) permissions <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> all AMP workspaces

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getRoleArn() {
  OUTPUT</span>=$(aws iam get-role --role-name $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Role.Arn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> --output text <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

  # Check </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> an expected exception
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ $? -eq <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $OUTPUT
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> [[ -n $(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">NoSuchEntity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> &lt;&lt;&lt; $OUTPUT) ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    &gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $OUTPUT
    return </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

#
# Create the IAM Role </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ingest with the above trust policy
#
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE_ARN</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$(getRoleArn $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE_ARN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ]; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  #
  # Create the IAM role </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> service account
  #
  SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE_ARN</span>=$(aws iam create-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">role \
  </span>--role-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE \
  </span>--assume-role-policy-document <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">TrustPolicy.json \</span>
  --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Role.Arn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output text)
  #
  # Create an IAM permission policy
  #
  SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ARN</span>=$(aws iam create-policy --policy-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_POLICY \
  </span>--policy-document <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">PermissionPolicyIngest.json \</span>
  --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Policy.Arn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output text)
  #
  # Attach the required IAM policies to the IAM role created above
  #
  aws iam attach</span>-role-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">policy \
  </span>--role-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE \
  </span>--policy-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">arn $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ARN  
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE_ARN IAM role for ingest already exists</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_INGEST_ROLE_ARN
#
# EKS cluster hosts an OIDC provider with a public discovery endpoint.
# Associate this IdP with AWS IAM so that the latter can validate and accept the OIDC tokens issued by Kubernetes to service accounts.
# Doing this with eksctl is the easier and best approach.
#
eksctl utils associate</span>-iam-oidc-provider --cluster $CLUSTER_NAME --approve</pre>
</div>
<p>执行以上脚本创建role</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>bash createIRSA-AMPIngest.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> </pre>
</div>
<p>使用以下内容创建名为&nbsp;<code>createIRSA-AMPQuery.sh</code>&nbsp;的文件。将&nbsp;<code class="code">&lt;my_amazon_eks_clustername&gt;</code>&nbsp;替换为集群的名称，并将 &lt;my_prometheus_namespace&gt; 替换为您的 Prometheus 命名空间。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>#!/bin/bash -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e
CLUSTER_NAME</span>=&lt;my_amazon_eks_clustername&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAMESPACE</span>=&lt;my_prometheus_namespace&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
AWS_ACCOUNT_ID</span>=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Account</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output text)
OIDC_PROVIDER</span>=$(aws eks describe-cluster --name $CLUSTER_NAME --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cluster.identity.oidc.issuer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --output text | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sed</span> -e <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s/^https:\/\///</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_AMP_QUERY_NAME</span>=amp-iamproxy-query-service-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">account
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE</span>=amp-iamproxy-query-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">role
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_POLICY</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">AMPQueryPolicy
#
# Setup a trust policy designed </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> a specific combination of K8s service account and namespace to sign <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> from a Kubernetes cluster <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">which</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hosts the OIDC Idp.
#
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> &lt;&lt;EOF &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TrustPolicy.json
{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Version</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2012-10-17</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,                   
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Statement</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
    {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Effect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Allow</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Principal</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Federated</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">arn:aws:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:oidc-provider/${OIDC_PROVIDER}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      },
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Action</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Condition</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">StringEquals</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${OIDC_PROVIDER}:sub</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system:serviceaccount:${SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAMESPACE}:${SERVICE_ACCOUNT_AMP_QUERY_NAME}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
EOF

   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Statement</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [

        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Action</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">aps:QueryMetrics</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">aps:GetSeries</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">aps:GetLabels</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">aps:GetMetricMetadata</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        ], 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Resource</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      }
   ]
}
EOF

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getRoleArn() {
  OUTPUT</span>=$(aws iam get-role --role-name $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Role.Arn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> --output text <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

  # Check </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> an expected exception
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ $? -eq <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $OUTPUT
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> [[ -n $(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">NoSuchEntity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> &lt;&lt;&lt; $OUTPUT) ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    &gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $OUTPUT
    return </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

#
# Create the IAM Role </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> query with the above trust policy
#
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE_ARN</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$(getRoleArn $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE_ARN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ]; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  #
  # Create the IAM role </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> service account
  #
  SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE_ARN</span>=$(aws iam create-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">role \
  </span>--role-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE \
  </span>--assume-role-policy-document <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">TrustPolicy.json \</span>
  --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Role.Arn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output text)
  #
  # Create an IAM permission policy
  #
  SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ARN</span>=$(aws iam create-policy --policy-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_POLICY \
  </span>--policy-document <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">PermissionPolicyQuery.json \</span>
  --query <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Policy.Arn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output text)
  #
  # Attach the required IAM policies to the IAM role create above
  #
  aws iam attach</span>-role-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">policy \
  </span>--role-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE \
  </span>--policy-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">arn $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ARN  
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE_ARN IAM role for query already exists</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IAM_AMP_QUERY_ROLE_ARN
#
# EKS cluster hosts an OIDC provider with a public discovery endpoint.
# Associate this IdP with AWS IAM so that the latter can validate and accept the OIDC tokens issued by Kubernetes to service accounts.
# Doing this with eksctl is the easier and best approach.
#
eksctl utils associate</span>-iam-oidc-provider --cluster $CLUSTER_NAME --approve</pre>
</div>
<p>执行以上脚本，创建role</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>bash createIRSA-AMPQuery.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;二、部署Prometheus</p>
<p>1.添加helm仓库</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm repo add kube-state-metrics https://kubernetes.github.io/kube-state-metrics
helm repo update</pre>
</div>
<p>2.创建部署Prometheus的命名空间</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>kubectl create namespace monitoring</pre>
</div>
<p>3.检查Amazon EBS CSI</p>
<p>如果EBS CSI组件没有附加对应的IAM role，需要在IAM 控制台中创建附有<a id="link-self:r5e:" class="awsui_link_4c84z_e562s_145 awsui_variant-primary_4c84z_e562s_247 awsui_font-size-body-m_4c84z_e562s_478" href="https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/iam/home#/policies/details/arn%3Aaws%3Aiam%3A%3Aaws%3Apolicy%2Fservice-role%2FAmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-testid="" data-awsui-analytics="{&quot;action&quot;:&quot;click&quot;,&quot;detail&quot;:{&quot;label&quot;:{&quot;root&quot;:&quot;self&quot;},&quot;external&quot;:&quot;false&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;#/policies/details/arn%3Aaws%3Aiam%3A%3Aaws%3Apolicy%2Fservice-role%2FAmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy&quot;},&quot;component&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;awsui.Link&quot;,&quot;label&quot;:{&quot;root&quot;:&quot;self&quot;},&quot;properties&quot;:{&quot;variant&quot;:&quot;secondary&quot;}}}" data-analytics-funnel-value="link:r5d:">AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy</a>权限且类型为AWS账号的role，否则EKS创建PVC时会报错</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="728" height="118" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/865838/202510/865838-20251019090047300-1540398726.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;4.创建storageClass</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>#cat sc.yaml<br>apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: ebs-sc
  annotations:
    storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true"
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
allowVolumeExpansion: true
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
parameters:
  type: gp3<br><br>#kubectl apply -f sc.yaml</pre>
</div>
<p>5.部署Prometheus</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>helm install prometheus prometheus -n monitoring -f prometheus.yaml</pre>
</div>
<p>6.查看Prometheus是否部署成功</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>kubectl get pods -n monitoring</pre>
</div>
<p>7.部署grafana</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>#cat grafana.yaml<br>---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: grafana-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: grafana
  name: grafana
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: grafana
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: grafana
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 472
        supplementalGroups:
          - 0
      containers:
        - name: grafana
          image: grafana/grafana:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
              name: http-grafana
              protocol: TCP
          readinessProbe:
            failureThreshold: 3
            httpGet:
              path: /robots.txt
              port: 3000
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 30
            successThreshold: 1
            timeoutSeconds: 2
          livenessProbe:
            failureThreshold: 3
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            successThreshold: 1
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3000
            timeoutSeconds: 1
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 750Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /var/lib/grafana
              name: grafana-pv
      volumes:
        - name: grafana-pv
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: grafana-pvc
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: grafana
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 3000
      protocol: TCP
      targetPort: http-grafana
  selector:
    app: grafana
  sessionAffinity: None
  type: ClusterIP<br><br>#kubectl apply -f grafana.yaml -n monitoring</pre>
</div>
<p>三、访问Prometheus和grafana</p>
<p>Prometheus和grafana部署完成以后，可以将SVC类型改为nodeport，然后通过ALB暴露出来，通过公网进行访问</p>
<p>grafana默认用户密码为admin/admin</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="817" height="658" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/865838/202510/865838-20251019095614408-1228247454.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
